{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Full House''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Full House'' attacked a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] being flown by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] near to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]]. Shortly afterwards, the [[Thaereian military]] ship [[Vigilant (CR90 corvette)/Legends|TNV ''Vigilant'']] arrived and prepared to engage the ''Full House''.
